posts.title: Pimalaya goes stable 🎉
posts.description: Himalaya v3, Neverest, Cardamum, Calendula and Carillon v1, Ortie and Comodoro v3, all at the top of the first stable version of pimdir. Why everything at once, how it was done, where the wizard went, and what comes next.

posts.title: Pimalaya for Android enters closed alpha
posts.description: The first Pimalaya app that gathers every domain the project covers, and everything built over the years to get there. It is not ready for everyone yet, so few chosen testers go first. Here how to apply.

posts.title: Another year with NLnet
posts.description: Pimalaya receives financial support for one more year, through the NGI Zero Commons Fund. Here the direction: consolidate the libs, standardise pimdir, generalise the sync, cover more domains, and ship better interfaces.
